Package com.egradx.notification.template

Class EgradxTemplateEngine

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.template.EgradxTemplateEngine
public class EgradxTemplateEngine extends Object
Renders a notification from its template: checks the model against the notification type's declared variables, finds the best template, and renders it strictly. 

 EgradxMessageContent content = templates.render(organizationId, "order.shipped", EgradxChannel.EMAIL,
         customer.locale(), Map.of("customerName", customer.name(), "orderNumber", order.number()));
 transport.submit(new EgradxOutboundMessage(organizationId, EgradxChannel.EMAIL, "order.shipped",
         content, List.of(customer.email())));

Every failure is an EgradxTemplateException thrown here, on the caller's thread, before anything is queued. A message that could not be rendered is never half-sent.
